composition_basis.closure_rule: Every accepted profile must have component fractions summing exactly to 1.0 and fixture component masses summing exactly to 100000000 microkilogram_proxy.
composition_basis.non_tunable_fixture_rule: Numbers in deterministic_fixture are exact oracle constants, not tunable parameters or real formulations. All tunable values appear in numeric_parameters with the complete parameter contract.
